name: Avvi Bulk SEO Editor for WooCommerce
author: avvidev

sections.description:
Avvi Bulk SEO Editor is a spreadsheet-style bulk SEO editor for WooCommerce stores. Four tabs, each with inline table editing, CSV template download, full CSV export, and CSV import/update with a background progress bar (safe for 1000+ rows):

1. Products – every product field (name, price, stock, description, categories, tags, slug, featured image, etc.) plus full Yoast SEO fields (SEO Title, Meta Description, Focus Keyphrase, Canonical, Noindex/Nofollow, Cornerstone, Open Graph fields, Schema Page Type, Schema Article Type, Breadcrumb Title).

2. Categories – Name, Slug, Parent Category, Description, Display Type, Extra Description, plus Yoast SEO fields for every product category.

3. Brands (shown automatically if WooCommerce Brands is enabled) – Name, Slug, Parent Brand, Description, Thumbnail (Media Library picker), Extra Description, plus Yoast SEO fields for every brand.

4. Pages – Page Title, Focus Keyphrase, SEO Title, Slug, Meta Description, and Featured Image (Media Library picker) for every WordPress Page.

Any image/thumbnail field lets you either pick an existing image from your Media Library or paste an external image URL (used automatically when importing a CSV) – external URLs are downloaded into the library once and reused on every later save, never re-downloaded.

Why this plugin

Most bulk-edit plugins only cover posts, or only cover WooCommerce products, or only cover Yoast fields in isolation. Avvi Bulk SEO Editor brings products, categories, brands, and pages together in one consistent spreadsheet interface, with full Yoast SEO field coverage for each, and a CSV round-trip workflow built to handle large catalogs (1000+ products) without timing out.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce (required)
  • Yoast SEO (recommended, for the SEO fields to have effect on your site)
sections.installation:
1. In wp-admin go to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin, choose the zip, Install, Activate.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is active (required).
  3. Go to “Avvi Bulk SEO Editor” in the left admin menu.

Important setup note

For slugs and clean SEO-friendly URLs to work at all, your site’s Permalinks must NOT be set to “Plain”. Go to Settings -> Permalinks and choose “Post name”, and under “Product permalinks” choose “Shop base” (not “Default”). This is a WordPress/WooCommerce requirement, not specific to this plugin – Yoast’s own Slug field will not save either until this is set correctly.
sections.faq:
Does this work without Yoast SEO installed?

Yes, the Products/Categories/Brands/Pages tables and CSV import/export still work. The SEO-specific fields (SEO Title, Meta Description, Focus Keyphrase, etc.) are stored in the same format Yoast SEO uses, so they take effect as soon as Yoast SEO is active.

How does CSV import matching work?

Product rows are matched by SKU (falls back to Product ID). Category/Brand/Page rows are matched by Slug (falls back to ID); unmatched category/brand rows are created as new entries automatically.

Will this slow down my site?

No. All processing happens in wp-admin only, using the same WordPress/WooCommerce APIs as the native admin screens.
